title: Social Media for Local Business — Reel 3

segments.narration: Facebook ads return $8.17 for every dollar spent for small businesses on average.

That number comes from 2026 small business ad data across real accounts. Instagram returns $5.78 per dollar. Both beat almost every other paid channel for local reach. And running ads from your local business page outperforms national brands using radius targeting in your area.
Start with $5 to $10 per day. One ad. Five to ten mile radius. Two weeks before you change anything.
Send this to a business owner who keeps saying social media doesn't work.
